items.name: Understandable Business
items.reason: Business model complexity is judged from the sector (PHARMACEUTICALS); simpler, transparent operations score higher.

items.name: Durable Competitive Advantage
items.reason: Combines the level of returns (ROE) and margins with how stable they have been over time — persistent high returns signal a moat.

items.name: High Return on Capital
items.reason: Returns on invested capital and equity versus market, sector and the company's own history — high, sustained returns indicate quality.

items.name: Conservative Balance Sheet
items.reason: Leverage and interest coverage judged against sector-appropriate limits (bank/utility norms differ from industrials).

items.name: Consistent Earnings Growth
items.reason: Multi-year revenue and EPS compound growth versus market and sector norms.

items.name: Strong Free Cash Flow
items.reason: Free-cash-flow margin plus cash conversion (operating cash flow vs net income) — real cash generation, not just accounting profit.

items.name: Honest Capital Allocation
items.reason: Share-count trend (buybacks vs dilution) and the direction of returns on capital — disciplined allocators avoid empire-building and dilution.

items.name: Stable Margins
items.reason: Lower year-to-year variability in gross/operating/net margins scores higher — pricing power and cost control.

items.name: High Owner Earnings
items.reason: Owner earnings ≈ net income + D&A − maintenance capex, as a share of revenue — the cash an owner could extract.

items.name: Predictable Business
items.reason: How steady revenue and earnings have been — predictable businesses are easier to value and less cyclical.

items.name: Conservative Accounting
items.reason: Cash flow from operations relative to net income — earnings backed by cash (low accruals) indicate conservative accounting.

items.name: Attractive Valuation
items.reason: Valuation multiples and yields versus the market, the sector, and the company's own historical range — cheaper relative to quality scores higher.

items.name: Management Quality
items.reason: Insider buying/selling, share dilution, and the trajectory of returns on capital as a read on management alignment and skill.
